events.title: Why Al Aqsa Still Calls Us
events.subtitle: Sada-e-Haq · A Call for Solidarity · Day 2
events.description: An invitation to reflect on the place of Al Aqsa in our faith and the meaning of solidarity with Palestine.
events.speaker: Ustaz Abdul Rehman Siddiqui & Mufti Atta-ur-Rehman · Al-Burhan Institute
notes: Audience and access arrangements were not specified in the supplied announcement.
This is an archived announcement. A recording has not been supplied.
body: Al Aqsa was the first direction we ever turned to in prayer, and it’s where the Prophet (SAW) stood and led every prophet before him on the night of Isra. Today it’s under occupation, and children in Gaza are still memorizing the Quran in the middle of the rubble. Most of us grew up knowing it matters, but few of us have ever sat down and asked why it still calls us after all this time.
LUMS Religious Society invites you to Sada-e-Haq: A Call for Solidarity. Day 2: Why Al Aqsa Still Calls Us, with Ustaz Abdul Rehman Siddiqui and Mufti Atta-ur-Rehman from Al-Burhan Institute.

body: What does it truly mean to put your complete trust in Allah when life feels uncertain? Join us for an inspiring session with Ustd. Zoha Malik as we explore how to anchor our hearts in Tawakkul. Come learn how to find inner peace and let go of anxiety by truly handing your worries over to Him (swt).
Bring your friends and see you all there, Inshallah!
